title: Any claimed owner can append new tasks mid-execution: creation separated from claiming, append-only graph, no auto-ownership, full notice fan-out
owner_note: Verifier-owned acceptance addendum extending the dynamic task graph contract. Locked before implementation completes, per lockstep. The initial planner becomes the first contributor of tasks; every claimed owner is an equal contributor thereafter.

pass_conditions.assert: a claimed owner, mid-execution, appends one or more new tasks via the same typed create path the planner uses; the appended tasks carry creator provenance (creating seat + turn id); at least one acceptance run shows a task created by a NON-planner seat; a build where only the planner can create fails.

an appended task enters open state unowned; the creator does NOT automatically own its child; if the creator wants it, it claims through the same atomic race as everyone else, and at least one run shows a child task won by a different seat than its creator.

the graph grows append-only: existing tasks are never retroactively mutated by a creator; appended tasks respect the same budget and duplicate-key guards as planner tasks (over-budget append is rejected with an auditable record); replay/restart does not duplicate appended tasks (idempotency key covers appended entries).

an appended task fans out capability-matched metadata-only notices exactly like planner tasks: no side-channel assignment, no body in the notice, declining seats keep zero body-reads and zero model turns.
appended tasks declare their phase and honor phase barriers; results on appended tasks carry the same owner+attempt fencing and exact-once receipt rules as planner tasks.

fail_signals: only the planner can create tasks in the live path
a creator auto-owns its child without an atomic claim
an append mutates an existing task retroactively
an appended task bypasses budget, dedup, notice fan-out, fencing, or receipt rules
regression_floor: All previously gated conditions (orchestration 15, dynamic graph 11, continuation 10) remain binding on the same SHA.
